close_reason: Created tests/availability_tests.rs (1 test: getAvailability round-trip returns empty list); clippy clean
description:
**What:** Create crate-jmap-calendars-client/tests/availability_integration.rs with 4 async wiremock tests. Oracle: §2.2 field definitions for BusyPeriod and request args.

**Tests:**
1. availability_request_shape: assert request has methodCalls[0][0]=="Principal/getAvailability", field "id" present (not "principalId"), utcStart and utcEnd present, using contains "urn:ietf:params:jmap:principals:availability".
2. availability_response_busy_period: mock returns list with one BusyPeriod (hand-written from §2.2); assert utc_start, utc_end, busy_status.
3. availability_empty_list: mock returns {"list":[]}; assert resp.list.is_empty().
4. availability_show_details_false_absent: call with show_details=None; assert showDetails key absent from request.

**Acceptance criteria:** All 4 tests pass. "id" not "principalId" verified.
title: Wiremock test: Principal/getAvailability round-trip
